metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear my crosshair was on vacation LOL what even happened?
metadata.description:
Wait, how did I even get this? My aim was clearly ghosting.
Enemy just walked into my accidental bullet.
Click if your best plays feel like pure chaos!
Valorant logic strikes again.

Tap if your aim’s more confused than your enemies!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
